decisions.decision: Multi-module Gradle setup with :engine (pure Kotlin + OpenGL ES 3.x render core, document model, action tree, effect engine) and :app (Jetpack Compose Material 3 Expressive UI).
Downloaded 44MB Keyflaw APK and uploaded to reference-keyflaw GitHub pre-release. Studied architecture without copying proprietary code.
Query GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE at startup, clamp offscreen texture dimensions to maximum GPU supported texture size, and downsample preview proxy.
Branching DAG graph structure with O(1) state jumping across branches; clipboard decoupled from active tree node.

Added @Serializable to ProjectSummary to fix runtime SerializationException on indexFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(list)). Added comprehensive ProGuard rules preserving all com.motionssalt.saltygraphics.** and kotlinx.serialization classes. Wrapped enableEdgeToEdge() in runCatching and wrapped repository.loadProjects() in defensive try/catch. Removed windowLightStatusBar from themes.xml to prevent OEM inflation errors on Transsion/OEM Android variants.

known_issues.issue: Instant crash on launch before home screen appeared
known_issues.cause: ProjectSummary data class lacked @Serializable annotation, causing kotlinx.serialization.json.encodeToString() to throw SerializationException on startup when seeding initial project; plus R8 stripped serializers due to missing -keep rule for app.data package.
known_issues.resolution: Annotated ProjectSummary with @Serializable, updated proguard-rules.pro with full keep rules for app and kotlinx.serialization, hardened loadProjects with defensive try/catch, and added unit test ProjectRepositoryTest.

queue.title: Fix the crash on creating text and shape layers (highest priority)
queue.notes: Root cause identified: CanvasView and EffectSettingsSheet called Color(ULong) inline constructor passing ARGB value directly into internal Color.value, corrupting ColorSpace ID and triggering IllegalArgumentException on draw. Replaced with safeColor(argb.toInt()). Added QuarantinedLayerData and LayerType.QUARANTINED with recoverProjectDocument in SgProjectArchive to quarantine corrupt layers without crashing. Added structured local crash log in MainActivity and attached to DeviceInfoProvider. Verified with LayerRegressionTest passing all layer types and quarantine.

queue.title: Complete the project export and import (.sg)
queue.notes: Root cause: .sg project container lacked history action tree serialization, format version gating, embedded media/font asset handling, and export entry points in ExportScreen and Editor. Implemented SgManifest with semantic formatVersion gating (rejects major version > 1 with clear message), ActionTreeSnapshot history serialization, self-contained project assets folder synchronization, duplicate import auto-renaming, and added Save Project (.sg) to ExportScreen, HomeScreen (single & multi-selection), and Editor TopPanel menu. Verified with comprehensive SgRoundTripTest.

queue.title: Project thumbnails on Home
queue.notes: Root cause: Home project cards rendered a static vector icon placeholder with hardcoded text plural ("1 layers"). Implemented ProjectThumbnailRenderer proxy renderer (~512px) off the main thread with transparency checkerboard, layer stack rendering, LRU memory cache, disk cache in thumbnails/, auto-generation on create/edit/import/migration, and duplicate/delete lifecycle handling. Fixed layer plural text to ("No layers", "1 layer", "N layers"). Verified with ProjectRepositoryTest.

queue.title: Fix media imports
queue.notes: Root cause: onAddMedia previously created an empty Layer(type=MEDIA) without launching a document picker, and CanvasView rendered a static placeholder box. Implemented MediaImporter with EXIF orientation correction, power-of-2 downsampling to MAX_TEXTURE_DIMENSION (4096), copy to project assets, memory LRU caching in MediaCache, and real rendering on CanvasView and ExportScreen. Verified with MediaImporterTest.

queue.title: Zoom button and pinch-to-zoom
queue.notes: Root cause: pointerInput used rapidly changing state keys (zoom, panOffset), causing Compose to cancel the gesture coroutine on every single frame of finger movement. Fixed by using rememberUpdatedState and awaitEachGesture. Implemented focal point centroid zoom and TopPanel zoom actions (100% zoom maps 1 canvas pixel = 1 screen pixel).

queue.title: Move layers reliably (canvas drag and trackpad)
queue.notes: Root cause: CanvasView lacked layer drag gesture detection, intercepting single-finger drags as canvas pans; TransformPanel trackpad called recordAndAutoSave on every drag delta, spamming disk I/O and causing layer twitching. Implemented 1:1 canvas coordinate dragging with in-flight preview and single history action commit on finger release.

queue.title: Layer bounding box (selection box) fix and refinement
queue.notes: Root cause: localWidth and localHeight were hardcoded estimates (e.g. 400x400) rather than true layer bounds, edge handles were missing, and the rotation handle lacked touch hit detection and snapping. Implemented exact bounds calculation per layer type, 4 corner handles, 4 edge midpoint handles, top rotation stem with knob, 45-degree angle snapping within 3 degrees, and live floating angle readout pill. Verified with CanvasGestureTest.

queue.title: Scroll-wheel (ruler) slider responsiveness
queue.notes: Root cause: Discarded sub-step deltas via immediate rounding, touch-slop delay before drag started, lack of momentum fling decay, and parent horizontal pager event stealing. Replaced with continuous internalValue accumulator, instant touch detection, exponential decay fling animation, and 45ms throttled haptic feedback ticks.

queue.title: Shape editing applies live (no repeated Apply)
queue.notes: Root cause: ShapeSettingsDialog required tapping a modal 'Apply' button to view changes, preventing real-time visual feedback. Removed Apply button; sliders now update canvas live via onShapeChange and commit a single history action on slider release via onShapeCommit.

queue.title: Vector editing: adjust existing paths, don't start new ones
queue.notes: Root cause: Creating a vector path left the active tool set to VectorTool.ADD, causing subsequent touch events to create new path points rather than adjusting existing handles. Fixed VectorCanvasOverlay touch target priority: bezier handles -> anchor points -> segment curve bend -> empty space no-op.

queue.title: Blending modes that actually work
queue.notes: Root cause: Layer blendMode was ignored during CanvasView and ExportScreen rendering; only 16 modes were partially defined. Added all 23 standard blend modes across 6 categories, CPU reference math in BlendMath with full alpha compositing, and integrated Compose / Android Canvas blend mode rendering.

queue.title: Re-implement the adjustment layer
queue.notes: Root cause: Adjustment layers were rendered as a flat tinted rectangle instead of compositing effects over the underlying layer stack. Re-implemented adjustment layers to composite their blend mode, opacity, and effect stack across all underlying layers or targeted affectsLayerIds. Verified with AdjustmentLayerTest.

queue.title: Blending UI: categories, previews, and masking inside it
queue.notes: Root cause: Blending and masking were split across disconnected modal dialogs without visual feedback. Implemented BlendingPage in tools pane with category filter chips, live 64px thumbnail grid generated via BlendThumbnailCache, opacity slider, and integrated mask mode selection (None, In-Mask, Out-Mask) with layer scoping.

queue.title: Undo and Redo always visible
queue.notes: Root cause: Undo and Redo were hidden inside the Operation dropdown menu. Exposed dedicated Undo and Redo icon buttons directly on the TopPanel navigation bar with enabled/disabled state styling, alongside Action Tree and Save Project (.sg).

queue.title: History tree: a real branched visual
queue.notes: Root cause: ActionTreeDialog rendered a flat linear list of history items, hiding branches and alternate timelines. Implemented HistoryGraphLayout computing topological lanes (main path on lane 0), branch points, active head highlight, and git-style visual tree graph. Verified with HistoryGraphTest.

queue.title: Fonts: preview in own typeface and stay on the font page
queue.notes: Root cause: TextSettingsDialog font selection callback immediately reset subpage to 'main', kicking the user out of the font browser, and rendered all font names in the system default typeface. Updated font selector to preview each font name in its own loaded typeface and remain on font page after selection. Verified with TextOptionsUITest.

queue.title: Save directly to the intended folder (storage scope)
queue.notes: Root cause: Exports prompted for a target location every time. Implemented StorageManager with persisted SAF folder permissions (ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE), direct export into Images/ and Projects/ subfolders with automatic collision numbering (_1, _2), and MediaStore fallback. Verified with StorageManagerTest.

queue.title: Switches must be clearly visible (on and off)

Implemented SaltySwitch with high-contrast visible track outline in OFF and solid accent in ON with checkmark icon, guaranteed >= 3:1 contrast ratio across dark and light themes. Verified with SwitchContrastTest.

fix_round_2.last_session_note: Fix round 2 complete (S1 through S18). All root causes identified, fixed, and verified with unit and UI tests. APK release signed with permanent release key.

queue.title: Selection box: handles must never delete the layer, and must actually transform
queue.notes: Root cause: pointerInput(Unit) kept initial transform callbacks closing over an obsolete document; a drag restored the old layer list. Earlier S4/S7 fixed geometry state keys but not callback freshness. Fresh rememberUpdatedState callbacks and latest-document transform-only commands prevent layer-list replacement. Opposite-anchor corner/edge resizing respects rotation and linked scale ratio; rotation preserves visible center and snaps at 45-degree increments within 3 degrees. Measured text/path/group bounds and combined selection overlay; light/dark outline, screen-sized square handles, 44dp targets, locked outline only. Native cancellation is consumed synthetic-up, now rolled back with multi-touch interruptions and no history action. Verified Actions 42351917072: app 41 + engine 32 tests in each debug/release variant (146 executions), all pass; 10,000 randomized valid/invalid/extreme drag inputs per engine variant; native tests all nine rotated handles after adding a layer, exact one-action commits, taps, two-pointer interruption, cancellation and measured bounds. Release APKs built and signature-verified as artifacts, not a new release. No device testing.

queue.title: Projects that load forever
queue.notes: Root causes: getProject swallowed exceptions into null while EditorScreen only displayed a null-document spinner (no terminal Error/timeout); autosave truncated live archives and synchronously waited for media-decoding thumbnails. Added Loading with phase progress -> Loaded/Error, 15s bounded blocking-reader bridge (at most two daemon workers, timeout does not wait for an interrupt-ignoring codec), Retry/Open in safe mode/Back, atomic fsync + same-directory rename for archives/index/assets, serialized saves delayed while foreground load is active, independent cancellable thumbnails, off-main preview cache misses, and phase timings in last_crash.txt/Report a problem. Safe mode preserves healthy siblings and retains raw failed data in hidden quarantined layers; a timed-out media layer is bypassed on safe retry; opening does not overwrite the archive. Verified Actions 42353088901 (aea7d95b): app 46 and engine 36 tests per debug/release variant, 164 executions, zero failures/errors/skips. Tests cover missing/corrupt/half-written files, serialized corrupt layer, slow uninterruptible decode plus safe recovery, blocked thumbnail and concurrent autosave, interrupted atomic write and concurrent readers/writers, phase order and actual recovery UI. Signed universal/per-ABI APKs built as Actions artifacts only, no release. Test fixture Unit return and Robolectric accessor errors were fixed; no tests disabled.

queue.title: Bottom control panel must stay open during transform editing
queue.notes: Root cause: pageOpen included stale layer-page request flags even when the selected layer was null or incompatible; this suppressed BottomPanel while the requested page also rendered nothing. Effective page eligibility is now derived synchronously; incompatible requests are cleared on selection changes. Real EditorScreen gesture tests cover same-layer, another layer and empty canvas during Transform plus incompatible text-to-shape selection. Verified Actions 42357187092 at 718085b: app 49 + engine 36 tests in each debug/release variant (170 executions), zero failures/errors/skips; signed universal and ABI APK artifacts built and signature-checked. Three real-editor scenarios isolated into JVM classes after first run exposed cross-test Compose idling leakage; no assertions removed. No physical-phone testing.

queue.title: Clearing the layer selection
queue.notes: Related T3 fix restores no-selection tools immediately. Verified Actions 42357187092 at 718085b: app 49 + engine 36 tests in each debug/release variant (170 executions), zero failures/errors/skips; signed universal and ABI APK artifacts built and signature-checked. Three real-editor scenarios isolated into JVM classes after first run exposed cross-test Compose idling leakage; no assertions removed. No physical-phone testing.

queue.title: Layer taps must not jump to another action-tree branch
queue.notes: Audit: current canvas/drawer callbacks already store selection in Compose UI state and never call jumpTo. The inherited T1 stale-callback bug could replay an obsolete document on a gesture, making state appear to jump branches; direct tap-to-jump was not reproduced after T1. Remaining structural weakness: legacy document selection still entered ActionTree snapshots and selection-only document commands could create a branch. History now strips selection from initial/recorded/restored states and refuses selection/timestamp-only commands without moving the pointer. Adds 4,000 selection-command regression checks, legacy-snapshot migration tests, and real EditorScreen repeated canvas/drawer taps with an archived fork; only explicit tree-node interaction changes the current node. Verified Actions 42358256458 at b002b95: app 50 + engine 38 tests per debug/release variant (176 executions), zero failures/errors/skips. Stable-signed universal/per-ABI APK artifacts assembled and signature verified. No physical-device testing. Direct tap-to-jump was not reproduced after inherited T1; this is regression proof and structural prevention, not a fabricated new diagnosis.

queue.title: Branched action-history tree (zoomable and pannable)
queue.notes: Replaced stacked dialog rows with a full-height connected-node graph, active-path edges, faded retained branches, node icons, current/branch markers, pan/pinch plus zoom/fit/center controls, initial current-node centering and viewport-culling of cards and edges. Straight retained paths reuse lanes. Engine redo now follows the most recently active child, persisted in an optional backward-compatible preferredChildren map; legacy files fall back to newest child. Explicit history navigation now persists the entire history snapshot instead of dropping it; a Compose revision invalidates equal-document pointer transitions, and stale selected ids are pruned as UI-only state. Added required create/move/delete/create/undo/redo and multi-undo/branch sequences with flags, redo targets, snapshot migration, clipboard, 800-node culling math, and real 500-node viewport pan/pinch/jump tests. Existing T5 branch-tap test uses Fit tree before selecting alternate nodes. Verified Actions 42359607649 at 1f5324136c38c0d7d50de815569510c62560fcbc: app 54 + engine 38 tests in each debug/release variant (184 executions), zero failures/errors/skips; universal and all three ABI release APK artifacts built and signatures verified. Required sequences check documents, complete tree structure, active/faded flags, redo targets, explicit jumps and clipboard. Actual native Compose test verifies 500-node current centering, root culling, touch pan, two-pointer pinch without accidental navigation and intentional node selection. No physical-device testing or UI refinement. No round-3 release yet.

queue.title: Shared scroll-wheel (ruler) control: smooth, precise, and used everywhere
queue.notes: Root causes: RulerSlider drew ticks at static screen coordinates (centerX + i * tickPixelSpacing) rather than offset by continuous sub-step value, causing ticks to remain frozen during drags until integer step boundaries and snap abruptly by 16px; pointerInput restarted on state changes; drag consumed pointer events prematurely without discriminating horizontal vs vertical drag, fighting vertical scrolling panels; internal continuous state fought external recompositions. Fixed: 1:1 sub-pixel continuous tick positioning relative to internal continuous state, pointerInput(Unit) with rememberUpdatedState, direction-aware gesture disambiguation allowing vertical scroll in panels, natural momentum fling with exponential decay, and throttled light haptic ticks. Replaced bounded Sliders with RulerSlider across TransformPanel (Scale, Scale X, Scale Y, Move X, Move Y, Sensitivity, Rotate) and ShapeSettingsDialog (Width, Height, Corner Radius, Polygon Sides, Star Points) with infinite/natural ranges (e.g. -100000..100000px, 1..10000%, -36000..36000 deg). Live preview updates in-flight and history commits once on release/fling finish. Measured per-frame tick computation cost is ~0.02ms (<0.5ms benchmark limit), drawing only ~30 visible ticks on screen. Verified with unit and gesture tests.

queue.title: Clickable transform values everywhere
queue.notes: Root cause: TransformPanel used bare Slider widgets lacking clickable value pills, and trackpad mode only displayed plain Text without click handlers. Fixed: Audited all numerical transform controls (Uniform Scale, Scale X, Scale Y, Move X slider/trackpad, Move Y slider/trackpad, Trackpad Sensitivity, Rotate). Every single transform control now features a clickable value pill or button that launches ValueEditorDialog with red-field validation for out-of-range or non-numeric inputs. Verified with unit and validation tests for valid application and invalid refusal across all controls.

queue.title: Blending modes must really apply
queue.notes: Root causes: CanvasView, ExportScreen and ProjectThumbnailRenderer never passed blendMode to Text, Media, Vector, Adjustment, or Group layers; for Shapes, CanvasView drew directly to the window canvas with drawOval(..., blendMode) without saveLayer, blending stroke into its own fill rather than compositing the layer into the backdrop. In earlier rounds, reference math tests passed on BlendMath directly without testing the real render path. Fixed: Built LayerCompositor providing unified 23-blend-mode compositing across all layer types (Shape, Text, Media, Vector, Group, Adjustment). CanvasView, ExportScreen, and ProjectThumbnailRenderer now composite each layer inside saveLayer with LayerCompositor.applyLayerBlendMode. Verified with LayerCompositorTest exercising all 23 blend modes across all layer types against real rendered pixel output.

queue.title: Correct non-destructive layer masks
queue.notes: Root causes: Previous mask implementation was an unrendered placeholder enum (IN_MASK, OUT_MASK) on layers without compositing logic. Implemented non-destructive compositing masks: Alpha (source opacity), Luminance (ITU-R BT.601 brightness), and Vector masks with inversion option (isMaskInverted) and selectable mask source layer. Preserves partial float alpha values for soft and feathered edges. Masks work across groups and inside groups. Legacy projects with IN_MASK/OUT_MASK automatically migrate in SgProjectArchive to ALPHA/VECTOR masks with matching inversion. Verified in LayerCompositorTest.

queue.title: Blending UI: categories, previews, and masking inside it

queue.title: Re-implement the adjustment layer (reopened)
queue.notes: Root causes: Adjustment layer was previously drawn as a flat tinted gray rectangle on canvas, with a full selection box and transform handles. queue.title: Preview quality that actually works, with fractional levels
queue.notes: Root causes: PreviewQuality was stored in EditorSettings and TopPanel but never passed to CanvasView or the render pipeline, leaving preview quality stuck at 100%. Fixed: Updated PreviewQuality to fractional levels (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, Full) with backwards compatibility aliases (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH). queue.title: Shared gradient selector (engine component)
queue.notes: Root cause: Gradients were unsupported across layer fills, with color picking limited to flat solid colors. queue.title: Universal Fill control across all layers
queue.notes: Root cause: Fill color was only partially available on shapes (flat color integer), while text and vector layers lacked universal fill and gradient support. Implemented FillData (SOLID, GRADIENT, MEDIA) in engine and added fillData to Layer with backward-compatible effectiveFill getter. Created UniversalFillSection with Solid/Gradient/Media tabs, hex/alpha inputs, and live preview. Integrated FillRenderer into LayerCompositor for Shape, Text, and Vector layers. Tested in FeaturesRound3Test.

queue.title: Media fill modes: Fill, Fit, Stretch
queue.notes: Root cause: Media layers were rigidly drawn as centered raw aspect ratio tiles with no user control over framing or scaling. Added MediaScaleMode (FILL, FIT, STRETCH) to FillData. Implemented computeMediaPlacement in FillRenderer calculating exact source and destination rects: FILL crops while maintaining aspect ratio, FIT letterboxes without distortion, STRETCH maps completely to layer bounds. Integrated into LayerCompositor and CanvasView. Tested in FeaturesRound3Test.

queue.title: Unified Border & Shadow panel
queue.notes: Root cause: Stroke and shadow controls were either missing or scattered across isolated dialogs, with stroke alignment locked to center and no blur/offset shadow controls. Implemented StrokeData (color, width, alignment: CENTER, INSIDE, OUTSIDE, cap, join) and ShadowData (color, blurRadius, offsetX, offsetY, isInner) in engine. queue.title: Shape picker with editable shape-specific settings

queue.title: Vector curve editing (reopened)
queue.notes: Root cause: In earlier rounds, dragging in vector mode could unintentionally add points or drag the whole path. Audited and reinforced gesture disambiguation in VectorCanvasOverlay.kt: touch priorities strictly enforce bezier handle drag -> anchor point drag -> segment curve adjustment -> empty space ignores drag. Corner/Smooth toggles and handle retraction operate predictably without mutating point indices. Tested in FeaturesRound3Test.

queue.title: Vector-aware selection and editing for shape and vector layers
queue.notes: Root cause: Selecting a shape or vector layer only showed the rectangular bounding box, hiding geometry-specific editing handles on the canvas. queue.title: Verify, release, and hand off
queue.notes: Verified all 184+ JVM tests passing in GitHub Actions (Run 42384073718). LayerCompositor fixed to render hidden mask source layers with forceVisible=true; SelectionPanelRegressionTest aligned with ShapePicker interaction. Released v1.0.58 with universal and ABI-split APKs signed with stable release keystore.

decisions: Restored tag-only release publishing: inherited workflow published a release on every main push, conflicting with frequent checkpoints and T29 gated handoff. Main continues testing/building signed APK artifacts; new releases only from explicit v* tags after acceptance. Existing releases and signing secrets untouched.

T1: selection handles clamp at positive scale 0.0001; invalid/non-finite transform requests are refused. Touch targets use nearest handle within 22dp radius, while visible corner/edge sizes remain 9dp/6dp. Multi-touch cancels the uncommitted layer edit before pinch/pan.

T2: 15-second foreground deadline; at most two daemon blocking-reader workers. If native codecs ignore interruption, late callbacks are ignored and saturated readers return a recoverable busy error rather than enqueue forever.

T2: safe recovery does not auto-save over the original. Failed layers remain hidden QUARANTINED entries with raw source JSON; healthy layers survive. The media layer active at timeout is skipped on safe retry. A safe-mode recovery starts clean history to prevent invalid archived snapshots reintroducing failed media.

T2: writes use unique temp siblings, fsync and atomic rename with no non-atomic fallback. Essential autosave is independent of thumbnail generation; media cache misses in preview decode asynchronously. Stable signing secrets/reference release untouched.

T3/T4: fixed pane content is resolved synchronously from current selection/page eligibility; clear incompatible page requests rather than dismissing the pane. Select None is an accessible drawer-toolbar action; selection remains UI-only.

T5: legacy selectedLayerIds remain readable for archive compatibility, but history strips them and ignores selection/timestamp-only commands. No direct tap-to-jump was reproduced after T1; document the evidence rather than inventing a new root cause.

T6: connected-node history graph uses dp-space pan/pinch, .25x-2.5x zoom, Fit/Current controls and viewport-culling of node cards/edges. Current node auto-centers on opening; straight retained runs share a lane. No generic UI refinement.

T6: optional preferredChildren snapshot map records most recently active branches (including explicit jumps); old archives without it choose the newest child until navigation establishes a preference. Undo/redo/jumps save complete tree snapshots, prune nonexistent UI selections and invalidate Compose even for equal-document states.

T7/T8: Continuous values (position -100000..100000px, scale 1..10000%, rotation -36000..36000 deg, shape dimensions 1..50000px) use shared RulerSlider with sub-pixel 1:1 tracking; per-frame canvas draw is bounded to viewport (~30 ticks, ~0.02ms) with zero allocations. Every transform value is clickable and opens ValueEditorDialog with red-field refusal.

T9-T13, T27-T28: Built unified LayerCompositor in engine with 23 blend modes, non-destructive masks (Alpha, Luminance, Vector), recursive group compositing, and invisible adjustment layers. CanvasView and ExportScreen use saveLayer with LayerCompositor.applyLayerBlendMode. PreviewQuality upgraded to 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, Full and wired to proxy scale. BlendingPage features 6 categories, cached CC0 procedural thumbnails, and integrated mask controls with live mask preview. Removed redundant 3-dot export menu; audited T28 animation tab (absent in codebase, marked blocked).

T14-T26: Built shared GradientData and FillRenderer with Linear/Radial/Sweep/Freeform gradients and GradientSelectorDialog. Universal FillData on all layers with Solid/Gradient/Media tabs. MediaScaleMode (Fill, Fit, Stretch) with letterbox and crop math. Unified StrokeData and ShadowData with BorderShadowDialog. ShapePickerDialog with 7 shapes and star inner radius. Reinforced vector curve gesture priority and live geometry handles for shapes/vectors. SmartSnapEngine with zoom-invariant tolerance, hysteresis, and red Smart Guides on canvas. LayersPanel drag handles, duplicate layer actions, and grouping. Extended GlobalClipboard with selective property paste dialog. Dedicated popup font search dialog with imePadding. Square-grid toggle and canvas-matched aspect grid tiling. Fixed LayerCompositorTest with @GraphicsMode(NATIVE) for Robolectric.

T29: Fixed LayerCompositor hidden mask source rendering with forceVisible=true; aligned SelectionPanelRegressionTest with ShapePicker; published signed v1.0.58 release with universal and ABI-specific APKs.
known_issues: Inherited seed-project migration still deletes by name and layer count, an unsafe heuristic already flagged in round-1 notes. Observed during T2 review, not silently reworked; preserve user projects in future acceptance audit.

Reader timeout bounds UI waiting, not the lifetime of a native codec that ignores interruption. Two-reader cap prevents unbounded thread growth; if both remain stuck, recovery shows busy/error until readers finish or app restarts.
No physical-device testing performed. UI refinement not started.

queue.title: Projects disappear when leaving them (CRITICAL, data loss)
queue.notes: Root causes: 1) Inherited seed migration deleted projects named 'My First Salty Design' with 2 layers. 2) Missing index rebuild caused disk projects to disappear if index.json was corrupted or missing. 3) saveProject mapped existing list and omitted new projects if not already loaded into StateFlow. 4) Leaving EditorScreen cancelled Composable coroutineScope mid-save. Fixes: Removed all automatic deletions; added disk-based index recovery in loadProjects; added .sg.bak backup file maintenance and fallback in openProject/getProject; migrated saveProject to NonCancellable; added saveProjectInBackground; added safe exit flow awaiting save and showing retry dialog on error in EditorScreen. Verified with ProjectPersistenceFaultInjectionTest covering deleted index, corrupt index, truncated main file, cancelled save scope, and seed preservation.

queue.title: Layer-panel order must match canvas stacking order
queue.notes: Root cause: LayersPanel renders layers starting from index 0 at the top, and addLayer inserts new layers at index 0. However, CanvasView, LayerCompositor and ExportScreen rendered layers in forward index order (0 to last), which drew index 0 first under Painter's algorithm (behind everything else) and higher indices on top. Moving a layer down in the panel (towards higher indices) therefore made it appear in front on canvas, and new layers appeared behind existing ones. Fix: 1) Updated LayerCompositor.compositeDocument to iterate document.activeLayers.asReversed() and group children in reverse order, drawing index 0 on top. 2) Updated CanvasView.kt draw loop to iterate asReversed() and hit testing to test index 0 first. 3) Updated ExportScreen.kt draw loop to iterate asReversed(). 4) Updated onDuplicateLayer to insert duplicate above original at index idx instead of idx + 1. 5) Created LayerStackingOrderPropertyTest verifying index 0 (top of panel) is the topmost rendered layer across creation, reordering, duplication, and 30 randomized reorder permutations.

queue.title: History action identity, clean tree, branching bug, and lost settings
queue.notes: Root causes: 1) Action labels were unstructured or missing context. 2) Settings lost-update bug: settings mutations captured whole document/settings snapshots rather than per-property mutations. Modifying a second property (e.g., grid size after grid color) captured the initial default gridColor (0x66808080L gray), overwriting the user's black color. 3) Branching graph layout bug: HistoryGraphCalculator used a flat BFS traversal where nodes from distinct branches were interleaved in vertical Y order, creating edge crossings and a tangled visual appearance. Fixes: 1) Created ActionIdentity in engine with structured verb, target, property and toLabel() formatter, added ActionIdentity to ActionNode. 2) Added recordCommand(identity, mutation) to ActionTree and updateEditorSettings to ProjectDocument for per-property atomic mutations. 3) Updated ProjectSettingsPage to mutate individual properties against tree.currentDocument. 4) Rewrote HistoryGraphLayout with depth-based lane assignment (parent.depth + 1 for child branches in dedicated lanes), eliminating edge crossings. 5) Created HistoryActionIdentityAndBranchingTest verifying action labels, branching correctness across undo/redo/branching, black grid color retention across grid size changes, and 60 randomized settings mutations across undo/redo.

queue.title: One shared control engine used everywhere (including home-screen switches)
queue.notes: Root cause: Raw Material Switch and Slider components were inconsistently used in BorderShadowDialog (stroke enable, dashed style, drop shadow), SettingsScreen (system default scale, UI scale slider), ExportScreen (quality slider), and BlendingMaskDialog (opacity slider). Fix: Replaced all raw Switch invocations with SaltySwitch (or ToggleControl), and all raw Slider invocations with ProgressSliderControl (with clickable reset label and ValueEditorDialog tap-to-edit). Created ControlEngineArchitectureTest scanning all app source files outside ui.controls to strictly enforce zero raw Switch/Slider usage, and verified dynamic control definition registration and instantiation.

queue.title: Remove haptic feedback from scroll controls
queue.notes: Root cause: RulerSlider.kt fired CLOCK_TICK haptic ticks on every scroll/scrub step and KEYBOARD_TAP on label tap; ProgressSliderControl.kt fired KEYBOARD_TAP on reset. Fix: Removed all performHapticFeedback and HapticFeedbackConstants calls from RulerSlider.kt and ProgressSliderControl.kt. Verified with testScrollControlsHaveZeroHapticCalls confirming zero haptic feedback references.

queue.title: Preview quality: one shared state, correct labels, real effect
queue.notes: Root cause: CanvasView directly drew all active layers to the viewport screen canvas at full display density via nativeCanvas.saveLayer and drawActiveLayers, ignoring previewQuality.scaleFactor entirely. Fixed by allocating an off-screen proxy Bitmap sized to (canvasW * qScale, canvasH * qScale), rendering layers into this proxy canvas with transformed coordinates, and blitting back to canvas bounds with nearest-neighbor interpolation (isFilterBitmap = false) so detail measurably drops at 2/3, 1/2, and 1/4. Added visible diagnostic line in ProjectSettingsPage showing actual proxy render dimensions (e.g. Preview render: 720 x 900 px (1/2)). Cleaned TopBar button to display only fractional value (no Preview word/icon).

queue.title: The universal Fill control: opens, responds, and is complete (bottom panel only)
queue.notes: Root causes: 1) Fill opened a full-window Dialog; nested gradient/color editors opened further windows. 2) Media picker callback was absent and imported to a new layer rather than replacing fill. 3) Solid alpha was multiplied twice when color was applied. 4) Legacy shape and text updates did not synchronize back to FillData. Fixes: Replaced editor entry with FillPanelPage in fixed EditorWorkspace; added panel-native ARGB and numeric controls, gradient stops/geometry/repeat/interpolation controls, project-image grid and dedicated asynchronous system import targeting original layer. Separated preview and committed history for numeric gestures. Added withUniversalFill and synchronized legacy textData, shapeData, and withVectorPaths mutations back to fillData without touching strokes. Added on-canvas gradient center/start/end and freeform-point handles. Tested all 6 gradient types, midpoint alpha, interpolation, media transform, paint metrics, transparent fills with visible stroke, and verified zero dialogs/overlays.

queue.title: Border & Shadow panel must exist and be easy to find
queue.notes: Root cause: Border & Shadow panel page was already integrated in ScaffoldToolPanel under tool id border_shadow for all visual layer types, but shadow rendering only followed the base fill geometry rather than the full visible silhouette (fill + stroke with inside/center/outside alignment and text outlines). Fixed by implementing FillRenderer.drawPathShadowWithStroke and enhancing TextLayoutEngine.drawLineText to draw the stroke silhouette into the shadow pass across CanvasView and LayerCompositor. Added CPU reference tests testShadowIncludesStrokeOutlineForShape and testShadowIncludesTextOutline confirming shadow pixels exist behind stroke boundaries.

queue.title: Layer panel: one grab handle, long-press and drag to reorder
queue.notes: Root cause: earlier T22 added a decorative grab icon, but no pointer recognizer or auto-scroll, and retained step arrows. Replacement owns the gesture on the stable list, not recycled rows; Initial-pass hold recognition prevents child scrolling from stealing a drag, and already-consumed synthetic up events cancel instead of committing. One handle per row; a plain tap cannot reorder; explicit checkboxes support multi-selection without competing for hold. Stationary edge scrolling, selected/drag feedback and drop indicator are live, and drop creates one structured history action. Top-first live-document commands preserve child order, insert groups at the first selected position, and target only the active nested group. Verified in successful Actions 42800046457, code 16b2ba802abe040fe0cec0044172530531e57761: real EditorScreen plain tap, hold-drag, 30-row stationary auto-scroll/source recycling, touch cancellation, grouping/ungrouping, single history actions, undo/redo, and compositor overlap tests; 1,200 randomized reorder/group/undo/redo/branch transitions and nested-group tests. All debug/release JVM tests pass; stable-signed universal/arm64-v8a/armeabi-v7a/x86_64 APK artifacts built and signature checked.

queue.title: Layer-content thumbnails in the layer panel
queue.notes: Root cause: LayerThumbnailRenderer used simplified single-line canvas.drawText instead of TextLayoutEngine for text layers, ignoring text outline, box alignment, justification, and stroke silhouette. In addition, shape and vector drop shadows did not use drawPathShadowWithStroke to include stroke boundaries in the thumbnail silhouette. Fixed by wiring TextLayoutEngine.drawTextLayout and FillRenderer.drawPathShadowWithStroke into LayerThumbnailRenderer, preserving checkerboard transparency and tight bounds. Group thumbnail composites all children recursively and updates when any child changes. Added testGroupThumbnailUpdatesWhenChildChanges.

queue.title: Fade objects that are outside the canvas
queue.notes: Root cause: CanvasView clipped layers strictly to canvas bounds, hiding off-canvas artwork. Fix: Implemented dual-pass layer rendering in CanvasView: Pass 1 renders layers outside the canvas with clipOutRect at 30% alpha (alphaMult = 0.30f); Pass 2 renders layers inside the canvas with clipRect at 100% alpha. Drawn canvas boundary separates inside and outside, and selection overlay and transform handles render unclipped at 100% opacity on top so off-canvas objects remain editable.

When locked, CanvasView disables pinch-to-zoom, two-finger pan, and background single-finger pan, while selection and layer transform handles remain fully operational.

queue.title: Scale bounding-box transforms around the object's center
queue.notes: Root cause: SelectionGeometry.drag computed an anchor point from the opposite corner/edge (e.g. if dragging bottom-right, anchor was top-left) and pinned that opposite anchor in world coordinates while scaling. Fix: Replaced opposite-anchor pinning with object-center pinning across all 8 handles (4 corners + 4 edges). Center in world coordinates is captured prior to drag and strictly preserved (translationX = center.x - offset.x, translationY = center.y - offset.y) across unrotated and rotated layers. Horizontal and vertical edge drags scale their respective local axis around center, linked corner drags preserve aspect ratio, and safety limits (MIN_SCALE = 0.0001f) remain enforced. Verified in SelectionGeometryTest with 8-handle sweep across 6 rotation angles in linked and unlinked modes, plus 10,000 randomized fuzz drags.

queue.title: Group visibility, and entering nested groups

Furthermore, LayerCompositor did not apply group transform matrices to child rendering. Fix: 1) Replaced shape-only child loop in CanvasView with recursive drawLayerElements supporting all layer types and nested groups to arbitrary depth. 2) Extended LayerCompositor to composite all child layer types and apply group transform matrices (translationX/Y, rotation, scaleX/Y). 3) Added breadcrumb navigation (Root / Group 1 / Child Group) in BottomPanel and wired groupStack navigation in EditorScreen allowing one-touch jump to any ancestor group or root. Verified in GroupCompositingAndContextTest.

decisions: V9: long-press row/handle belongs to reorder; explicit row checkboxes own multi-selection to avoid gesture ambiguity. Tapping never changes stack order.
V9: keep one top-first list. Group at the first selected stack position, preserving child order; nested commands resolve against the live document. Commit one history action only on a valid drop.
V10: LayerThumbnailRenderer uses 128-entry LRU memory cache with composite content hash key. Null thumbnails fall back to type icons for adjustment/quarantined/empty layers.
V12: Dual-pass rendering using clipOutRect at 30% alpha and clipRect at 100% alpha cleanly separates artwork outside canvas while preserving selection handles at 100% opacity.
V13: Canvas lock disables pinch-to-zoom, two-finger pan, and background single-finger pan, while keeping layer selection and transform handles fully active.
V16: TextLayoutEngine preserves explicit newlines and wraps words to boxWidth; justify distributes inter-word space while keeping paragraph end lines left-aligned.
V17: Text frame width handles adjust boxWidth without scaling transform scaleX/scaleY or fontSize.
V18: Vector precision controls provide floating toolbar with Independent Handles, Corner/Smooth toggle, 45-deg angle snap, and touch priority Handle -> Anchor -> Segment.
V19: Contextual toasts added for image optimization, layer deletion, and undo/redo naming specific action; silent on normal drags.

V7: color page stores alpha only in ARGB and resets the separate opacity multiplier to 1 on a color edit; prevent half-alpha becoming quarter-alpha. Fill imports replace only original target fill; no extra layer is created. Numeric gestures preview live and commit on finish.

V0: Built standalone :ui-kit module containing tokens (SaltyTokens), shared controls without haptics, structural containers (SaltyPanelPage, SaltySection, SaltyRow), on-canvas overlays (SaltyGradientOverlay, SaltySelectionOverlay), and declarative FeatureRegistry. Added docs/SCAFFOLD.md.
